bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (View, ViewBase, controls.rs, forms.rs, scroll.rs), bifrost_ui::values, springboard/ui/src/visual_effect.rs
summary: A retained view tree with buttons, switches, sliders, segmented controls, steppers, a text field, progress indicators, stacks, forms and a vertical scroll view exists and is shared by form factors. Per-view bounds and transforms, control events and states, pickers, a calendar picker control, bar items and the large content viewer are missing.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.apple: UIView (frame, bounds, center, transform, hit testing, subviews, tag, alpha, clipsToBounds)
features.note: View trait with ViewBase: frame, hidden, enabled, opacity, background, hit_test, children, optional backing layer. Frames are in window points; there is no bounds origin, no transform and no per-view clipping flag (only ScrollView clips)

ViewBase::send_action queues a named action that travels up the responder chain; there is no event mask (touchDown, touchUpInside, valueChanged), no highlighted or selected control state and no touch-inside tracking
Button with title, symbol and pressed state; no configuration styles (plain, tinted, filled, glass), no menu button, no toggle button

features.feature: Switch, slider, stepper, segmented control, page control
features.note: switch, slider, segmented control and stepper have SDK views; the page control has a model only. Sizes follow the desktop control metrics; touch-size variants (44 pt targets, drag-to-toggle on the switch) are not set up
ProgressIndicator draws a bar, an indeterminate bar and a spinner, animated from View::tick
month grid and a mini month calendar drawing exist; no wheel or compact date picker, no time picker, no multi-date selection or per-day decorations as a view
no spinning-wheel value picker. Needed on touch for dates, times and short option lists; build on the scroll physics in springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs with snap-to-row
a colour panel model exists; no well control that opens it from a touch UI
an empty-state view with symbol, title, text and an action is not a shared component; apps draw their own
PNG and JPEG decoding and drawing into a rect; no content-mode (aspect fit, fill) view and no animated image sequence view
vertical and horizontal stacks with spacing, insets and alignment; no fill-equally or equal-spacing distribution modes, no arranged-subview hiding animation

features.apple: UIScrollView (contentOffset, zoomScale, paging, bounces, indicators, keyboard dismiss)
features.note: vertical drag, fling with exponential deceleration, rubber band and a thin indicator. No horizontal or two-axis scrolling, no pinch zoom, no paging, no scroll-to-top tap, no interactive keyboard dismiss
Label and a single-line TextField with editing, undo and text input client wiring; the multi-line text view is a model without an SDK view. See uikit-text-input-keyboards
search field geometry with a clear button; no tokens, no scope bar, no cancel button behaviour
material catalogue, vibrancy and glass styles reach apps through the window server; independent of input device

toolbar with validation and overflow, and a source list sidebar. There is no bottom tab bar and no navigation bar with large-title collapse. A tab bar is the main top-level navigation on a touch tablet
accessibility aid for large text sizes; needs content size categories with accessibility sizes; only a continuous text scale exists (Configure.text_scale)
advertising attribution tied to the vendor's ad services
EdgeInsets and Rect helpers; no directional (leading and trailing) insets, so right-to-left layout is not mirrored

gaps: Per-view bounds, transform and clipping (needed for zoom, rotation and scrolling in both axes)
Control events and control states (highlighted, selected)
Bottom tab bar and large-title navigation bar
Wheel picker, date and time picker controls
Touch-size control metrics (44 pt targets) selected by form factor
